# ui::SvgImage

Header: `winui/render/SvgImage.hpp`.

An SVG document as image content: the markup, kept as text, plus the natural size read from its root element.

Nothing here interprets the drawing. [Renderer::draw_svg()](renderer.md#draw_svg) hands the markup to the renderer, which draws a subset of SVG. Copies share one immutable markup string, so passing an SvgImage around by value is cheap.

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::SvgImage logo = ui::SvgImage::read("assets/logo.svg"); // throws if unreadable
const ui::SvgImage dot{R"(<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16">
                               <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="`#0078D4`"/></svg>)"};

// The logo drawn at 64x64, the dot at twice the 16x16 its root element gives.
window.set_content(ui::HorizontalStack{
    .spacing = 8,
    .content = {
        ui::Image{.source = logo, .width = 64, .height = 64},
        ui::Image{.source = dot, .width = 2 * dot.natural_size().width, .height = 2 * dot.natural_size().height},
    },
});
```

## SvgImage

```cpp
SvgImage() = default
```

An empty document; draws nothing.

## SvgImage

```cpp
SvgImage(std::string markup)
```

UTF-8 SVG markup. Throws nothing: a document whose root cannot be read has a zero natural size, and a backend that cannot parse it draws nothing.

## empty

```cpp
bool empty() const
```

True when there is no markup.

## markup

```cpp
std::string_view markup() const
```

The UTF-8 markup as given; valid while this SvgImage (or a copy of it) lives.

## natural_size

```cpp
Size natural_size() const
```

The root element's size in DIPs (see [svg_natural_size()](namespace-ui.md#svg_natural_size)); zero when it has none.

## read

```cpp
static SvgImage read(const std::filesystem::path& path)
```

The file at `path`, read as UTF-8. Throws std::runtime_error if it cannot be read.
